assignmentHtml.task:
调查以下频道组的企业所有权及关联关系链：

  1. Kids Diana Show、Toys and Colors、Ryan's World：均为 Pocket.watch 的合作伙伴。各自何时与 Pocket.watch 签约？协议包含哪些内容？
  2. SET India 和 Sony SAB：均属于 Sony Pictures Networks India。确认其共同运营方。
  3. Zee TV 和 Zee Music Company：确认两者的母公司是否同为 Zee Entertainment Enterprises。
  4. Movieclips：Fandango Media 合资企业（Versant 75%，Warner Bros Discovery 25%）。Versant 是何时取得多数股权的？
  5. News18 India：Reliance Industries 对 Network18 的所有权。RIL 是何时取得控制权的？
  6. StarPlus 和 Vijay Television：JioStar 合资企业（Viacom18 + Disney India）。何时成立？
  7. WWE：TKO Group Holdings 的成立日期。
  8. MaviGadget：Brandimi LLC 的创始人 Ahmet Yanik。
  9. Cool Items Official：匿名内容策展者模式。查找任何公开披露运营方身份的信息。
assignmentHtml.context:
本任务用于制作研究图谱。调查以下事项：

  1. Kids Diana Show、Toys and Colors 和 Ryan's World 之间存在什么企业关系？三者均与 Pocket.watch 签有协议。查找附有日期的公告。
  2. T-Series 各频道（T-Series 主频道、T-Series Bhakti Sagar、T-Series Tamil 等）之间是什么关系？
  3. SET India 与 Sony SAB 是什么关系？两者均属于 Sony Pictures Networks India。
  4. Zee TV 和 Zee Music Company：是否拥有同一母公司 Zee Entertainment Enterprises？
  5. Movieclips：Fandango Media 的合资结构（Versant 75%，WBD 25%）。核实这一点。
  6. News18 India：通过 Network18 隶属于 Reliance Industries。
  7. StarPlus 和 Vijay Television：两者均属于 JioStar（Disney + Reliance）。
  8. WWE：TKO Group Holdings（Endeavor 合并）。核实日期。
  9. MaviGadget：Brandimi LLC、Ahmet Yanik。
  10. Cool Items Official：匿名运营方，在美国注册，内容来自中国。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 经核实的企业关系，每组均附来源 URL 及日期。

answerHtml:
Verified corporate relationships for all nine groups:

(1) KIDS DIANA SHOW, TOYS AND COLORS, RYAN'S WORLD — All three are INDEPENDENT creator-owned YouTube channels that signed separate partnership deals with Pocket.watch Inc. They share no common ownership; the only corporate relationship is their shared status as Pocket.watch partner/creator portfolio members. Deals:
• Ryan's World (Ryan ToysReview): Signed September 2017 as a long-term partnership; consumer products brand 'Ryan's World' created February 2018.
• Kids Diana Show: Partnership announced May 19, 2020, launching 'Love, Diana — The Princess of Play' franchise including original series, consumer products (9 licensees), mobile gaming.
• Toys and Colors: Partnered October 7, 2021, launching 'Kaleidoscope City' franchise (series, consumer products, gaming, live events).

(2) SET INDIA & SONY SAB — CONFIRMED shared operator: Sony Pictures Networks India (SPN), a subsidiary of Sony Corporation (Japan). SPN was formerly named SET India Private Limited (1995–2007). SPN acquired SAB TV in 2005 and rebranded it as Sony SAB. Both channels are listed among SPN's 26 television channels.

(3) ZEE TV & ZEE MUSIC COMPANY — CONFIRMED same parent: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited (ZEEL). Zee Music Company was launched by ZEEL on March 31, 2014 as a dedicated music acquisition/distribution venture, with ZEEL CEO Punit Goenka as its key executive.

(4) MOVIECLIPS — FANDANGO MEDIA JV STRUCTURE VERIFIED: Movieclips was founded in 2009 by Zefr, acquired by Fandango in 2014 (renamed Fandango Movieclips, later Rotten Tomatoes Movieclips in 2022). Fandango Media is a joint venture: Versant 75%, Warner Bros. Discovery 25%. Warner Bros.' stake was originally 30% (from the Feb 2016 Rotten Tomatoes/Flixster deal), reduced to 25% by 2019. Versant was spun off from Comcast in January 2026 as a public company, inheriting the 75% Fandango Media stake.

(5) NEWS18 INDIA — RELIANCE INDUSTRIES CONTROL: RIL established Independent Media Trust (IMT) on January 3, 2012, providing ₹5,400 crore to Network18. Transaction completed 2013 with RIL as passive investor with indirect control. Hostile takeover completed July 7, 2014 when RIL became new promoter group with 78% shareholding after MD Raghav Bahl resigned May 27, 2014. News18 brand adopted 2016.

(6) STARPLUS & VIJAY TELEVISION — JOIOSTAR JV: JioStar formed November 14, 2024, when Viacom18 merged into Disney Star (Disney India subsidiary). Deal valued at $8.5 billion. StarPlus and Star Vijay (Vijay TV acquired by Star India in 2001, renamed Star Vijay) are both channels under JioStar. Ownership: Reliance 63.16% (16.34% direct + 46.82% via Viacom18), Disney India 36.84%.

(7) WWE — TKO GROUP HOLDINGS: Formed September 12, 2023, via merger of WWE and Endeavor's UFC (Zuffa). Listed on NYSE (ticker TKO). Initial ownership: Endeavor 51%, WWE shareholders 49%. Valued WWE at $9.3 billion.

(8) MAVIGADGET — BRANDIMI LLC: Brandimi LLC d/b/a MaviGadget, located at 4610 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60640. Business incorporated May 13, 2019 (as LLC); business started December 22, 2010. Founder/Principal: Ahmet Yanik, confirmed by BBB Chicago and LinkedIn profiles.

(9) COOL ITEMS OFFICIAL — ANONYMOUS CURATOR: No publicly identified company or formal business entity behind this channel (~38.3M subscribers). Social media presence linked to Instagram account @cool_ltems_official operated by an individual identified as 'Toha,' with a Facebook page 'JiuJiuHaoWu.' Channel bio states: 'All videos are authorized by creators from Mainland China.' Content is family-themed product recommendations curated from Chinese creators. US-based operation but operator identity remains unconfirmed beyond the 'Toha' handle.
